title: feat: add Qwen3.8 Max
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds paid-only `qwen3.8-max` alongside the unchanged `qwen3.7-max` service, with no new aliases.
- Routes `qwen/qwen3.8-max` through OpenRouter to Alibaba only, with provider fallback disabled and no Pollinations fallback.
- Publishes text, image, and video inputs at OpenRouter's current $2/M prompt, $0.25/M cache-read, $2.50/M cache-write, and $6/M completion rates.
- Adds one focused resolver test and the required effective-price snapshot.

Tests: direct Alibaba and full local Pollinations E2E passed 10-image and 10-video requests; cached-video billing matched exactly. Gen typecheck and 66 focused tests passed; Enter alias, pricing, variant, and snapshot tests passed (367).

gist.headline: A fresh Max bloom
gist.blurb: Qwen3.8 Max has landed in the hive as a paid-only model, with its route pointed straight at Alibaba. Bring text, images, or video; the new blossom knows what to do with all three.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only qwen3.8-max model alongside unchanged qwen3.7-max, routed exclusively through Alibaba on OpenRouter with no provider or Pollinations fallback, at $2/M prompt, $0.25/M cache-read, $2.50/M cache-write, and $6/M completion tokens.
gist.impact: Developers can now use qwen3.8-max for text, image, and video inputs with explicit Alibaba-only routing and published multimodal token pricing.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Qwen3.8 Max as a newly cultivated, clearly labeled code-flower in a cozy model garden, with a direct dedicated pipe running from an Alibaba-inspired cloud kiosk to the flower and no branching fallback paths. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener's hat and carrying a price-tag clipboard, inspects the new bloom while a retro terminal shows text, image, and video icons; small surrounding flowers and code vines keep the scene warm and open-source-minded.
